def run(scene, robot):
    a = scene.get("light blue box cutter")
    b = scene.get("white glue bottle")

    temp = scene.free_spot(size=(a.w, a.d), clearance=3)

    robot.move(scene.get(b.name), ax, ay)
    robot.move(scene.get(a.name), bx, by)

    robot.move(scene.get(b.name), ax, ay)
